title: General Tech Discovery
description: Explore computer science, programming, web basics, data, cloud, security, and career direction before choosing a specialization.

topics.name: How Computers Work
topics.description: Understand binary, CPU, memory, operating systems, files, processes, and the internet at a beginner-friendly level.

topics.name: Internet and Web Basics
topics.description: Learn HTTP, DNS, browsers, hosting, domains, clients, servers, APIs, and why web apps work.

resources.title: How the Internet Works in 5 Minutes (Aaron)

topics.name: Git and GitHub
topics.description: Practice version control, commits, branches, pull requests, READMEs, and sharing projects publicly.

resources.title: Complete Git and GitHub Tutorial (Kunal Kushwaha)

project.title: Learning Journal Repository
project.description: Create a GitHub repo with notes, small exercises, and weekly reflections across different tech areas.

topics.name: Programming Fundamentals
topics.description: Learn variables, functions, conditions, loops, lists, dictionaries, debugging, and reading error messages.

topics.name: Data Structures and Algorithms Basics
topics.description: Understand arrays, strings, maps, stacks, queues, recursion, sorting, searching, and complexity at a practical level.

topics.name: Practice: Build 10 Tiny Programs
topics.description: Build small CLI tools like calculator, quiz, todo list, file renamer, password checker, and API fetcher.

project.title: Command-Line Toolkit
project.description: Build 3 small CLI tools, write usage instructions, and publish them in your learning repository.

topics.name: Web Development Taste Test
topics.description: Try HTML, CSS, JavaScript, DOM updates, forms, and a simple API-powered page.

topics.name: Data and AI Taste Test
topics.description: Try spreadsheets, SQL, Pandas, charts, and a small prediction or classification example.

topics.name: Cloud and Security Taste Test
topics.description: Explore Linux, networking, cloud hosting, logs, basic security hygiene, and safe lab environments.

project.title: Three-Track Sampler
project.description: Build one tiny web page, one data notebook, and one cloud/security notes lab, then compare which felt most interesting.

topics.name: Strengths and Work Style
topics.description: Compare your interest in visual work, logic, systems, data, security, writing, product thinking, and operations.

topics.name: Portfolio Basics
topics.description: Write READMEs, explain decisions, include screenshots, list setup steps, and show what you learned from each project.

topics.name: Project: Personal Career Map
topics.description: Choose 2-3 target roles, compare skills, pick one roadmap, and create a 30-day project plan with checkpoints.

project.title: 30-Day Specialization Plan
project.description: Pick one roadmap, define weekly outcomes, choose one portfolio project, and set review checkpoints.
